name: Tooltip
summary: A tooltip is a short description that appears on hover and on keyboard focus. Use it for something helpful about a control that is not required to operate it. Content shown on hover has to be dismissible, hoverable and persistent (SC 1.4.13), and touch users cannot summon one at all.
demoNote: Press Esc with the pointer still on a trigger, then move the pointer from a trigger onto its bubble — those two are what most tooltips fail. Example 3 is the toggletip, which is the version that works on a phone.

contract.useWhen: A description on hover and focus, plus the toggletip for touch.
keyboard: native: moves to the trigger, which shows the bubble. The bubble is never a tab stop
dismisses, and the dismissal is remembered until focus or the pointer moves
failureModes: hover only, which fails all three of dismissible, hoverable and persistent (SC 1.4.13)
pointer-events:none on the bubble, the usual hoverable failure
aria-describedby toggled with visibility, taking the text from the people who rely on it
a tap leaving a bubble stuck open — filter on pointerType === 'touch'
interactive content inside the bubble, which nothing can reach
essential information only in a tooltip, which touch users often cannot summon
api: AC.createTooltip(root, options) -> { show, hide, isOpen, trigger, tip, destroy }
